character: regime concrete, poured thin over too little rebar: it maps into plates, spalls in angular flakes, and when it goes it shows its rusty ribs, bent the way the blast pushed them
hash: h32(x, y, k) as in tools/art_host/fx/hashrule.py (JS given there), LEVEL coordinates; keys: TOP 1, BOTTOM 2, LEFT 3, RIGHT 4; + 0 join level, + 16 variant, + 32 corner, + 48 section; + salt

strips.layout: column = variant v, row = pair p = ia * 4 + ib (ia, ib = the level index of the start / end vertex)

cracks.use: columns = variants, rows = stages (25 / 50 / 75 % of dmg / threshold), cumulative. The canvas is the cell + 8 px a side: draw it centred on the cell OVER the neighbours (clip to matter), so the fracture lines cross the border 4-12 px; a line never runs along a cell border.

bites.use: one per pellet, centred on the hit point, over the cell art; random variant

rebar.use: along every lip of a hole: walk the lip pixels in order; the gap to the next sprite is 5 + h32(x, y, 48 + salt) % 16 px; the variant is h32(x, y, 49 + salt) % 12; turn the sprite so it points away from the matter (down out of a lip above, rotate 90s); clip to the hole. Aggregate sprites (variants 9-11) sit in the section band.

facets.#ff0000: top: the art one ramp step lighter
facets.#00ff00: front: the art as it is
facets.#ffdc00: rebar: REBAR[2], its lower pixel REBAR[1]

chunks.use: a removed cell gives 3-6 chunks: shape = h32(cx, cy, 60 + i + salt) % 8, the art cut from the cell at offset (h32(..., 61 + i) % 16, h32(..., 62 + i) % 16), turned by (h32 % 4) x 90 deg and flipped by bit 2; each landed chunk gets a 1 px RAMP[0] contact under its lowest row and settles on a cone of repose of 36 deg. The heap keeps about a third of the removed volume; the rest is dust.

facets.#00ff00: the wall's painted face kept AS IT IS (it reads as a piece of this wall)
facets.#ff0000: the broken top edge: the section, lit

slabs.use: holes of 3+ cells: min(4, 1 + n // 2) slabs, cut from removed cell (i * 3) % n at hashed offsets (keys 64-66), leaning on the wall foot by a shear of one px every 2-3 rows (alternate sides), 1 in 3 stood on end; then the chunks on a 36 deg cone within +-min(32, 10 + 6n) px of the hole centre; grains at the toe

stages.note: opaque overlays drawn over the cell art, never alpha
